audience.en: Dewi, who runs a batik workshop in Yogyakarta with two artisans and IDR 20 million to start selling silk and cotton scarves abroad in 2027.
audience.id: Dewi, pemilik bengkel batik di Yogyakarta dengan dua perajin dan IDR 20 juta untuk mulai menjual syal sutra dan katun ke luar negeri pada 2027.

localeReason: English and Indonesian: Dewi is an Indonesian maker in Yogyakarta, so Indonesian serves her directly for the customs, tax and bank steps that run through Indonesian agencies and banks, while English keeps the platform, carrier and buyer-country rules in the language those sources use. Neither page changes eligibility or the unconfirmed items.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Public pages, rate-guide PDFs and policy documents read on 2026-11-07 with no accounts, contacts, quote requests or form submissions. Some fetches silently fell back to an existing managed browser profile, so the research cannot be certified clean-session; later checks used fresh cookie-empty browser contexts.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Not readable or only partly read: the Etsy photography article, the Australian Taxation Office GST page, the Pos Indonesia tariff page (script shell), the FTC textile guide (partial), parts of the Etsy fee policy, eBay and CBP pages (verification pages) and the Xendit pricing page. Search-index snippets are not treated as full-page reads.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: The independent check recomputed every displayed sum, per-scarf row, monthly ramp, budget, buyer-tax example, DHL sensitivity and Shopify break-even and found no arithmetic error. Its main finding was that the first two lanes (Japan and Australia) also lose money at the published DHL base, not only the US; this page states that near the top and in the shipping section, with the Japan, Australia, US and EU figures. It also asked that the IndoShip samples cite H3 to H6, that the 11,000 sensitivity be read beside 11,500 including the 0.5% provision, and that Offsite Ads may become mandatory during September in the ramp; all are reflected. It directly read only the DHL, PP 20/2026, EU customs-guidance and US postal-rule documents, so other fee and legal items remain registry-level and unconfirmed.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: The original HTML layout was checked by the run at 1440 and 390 pixel widths; no visual check was made of this page, which is Markdown rendered by the site.

datePolicy: All source access dates are 2026-11-07 from the run register; a read date is not an effective date. Future dates (2027 launch, 2 December 2026 eBay change, 1 July 2028 EU duty end) stay separate from read dates. No external refresh.
uncertainties: No accepted all-in 200 g shipping lane at the modelled IDR 400,000 charge; Japan and Australia lose money at published DHL bases unless the customer charge changes; 2027 DHL prices and surcharges unconfirmed
Pos Indonesia 200 g rates, billing steps and US acceptance not obtained; IndoShip samples are 1 kg and their fee inclusion is unconfirmed
